requester_requirements: This arm uses a random theme-appropriate concept related to the current topic resolved through actual previous requester text.
Use the supplied reference image in prompt and generation.
Generate an image and judge whether the topic is visually realized.
authorial_realization: A fictional military performer in exaggerated ceremonial tailoring treats inspection of an ordinary boot as a solemn event. Costume and bodily interaction carry the absurd military hierarchy, rather than relying on the genre label or readable text.

pixel_gates.requirement: Military role reads from the subject plus beret, structured parade jacket and orderly ceremonial hardware in one frame. A red palette alone is insufficient.

An ordinary recognizable boot is elevated on a small presentation plinth while the richly decorated performer gives it a solemn meticulous inspection; actor, mundane object, presentation relation and inspection action must be visible together. Generic military portrait alone fails.

The performer owns the two visible gloved hands; one palm supports the plinth under the boot and the other hand's index fingertip visibly meets the toe leather. Both contact endpoints must be visible; obscured contact is UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS.
The main face and dark chin-length bob with fine bangs remain assessable at the delivered scale against the supplied reference. Similarity is a visual judgment only, with no identity claim.
The exaggerated tailored costume, poised face and deliberate editorial lighting form a coherent person-centered fashion photograph; props do not erase the person.

scoring_policy.FAIL: A visible required component or relation is absent or contradicted.
scoring_policy.UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS: Partial or obscured evidence cannot pass a full gate.
scoring_policy.BLOCKED_UNSCORED: A blocked attempt without an actual image file has no pixel score.
scoring_policy.overall: partial_is_fail; source, retrieval, prompt audit and runtime success do not establish pixel PASS.

generation_budget: One built-in image_gen call for this arm; preserve exact audited runtime prompt; no automatic same-prompt repeat.

genre_specificity_review.scope: One independently authored facet of the topic: absurd military discipline in an inflated ceremonial fashion portrait.
genre_specificity_review.limit: Red military clothing, a beret, a boot or a military role alone cannot prove the broader named internet genre. Pixel review must separately state whether the combined action reads as military absurdist satire and whether topic-specific recognition remains uncertain. A passed costume gate cannot establish exhaustive topic fidelity.
genre_specificity_review.forbidden_inference: The image cannot establish actual military affiliation, real coercion, identity, consent, a prior event or unseen violence.
